result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and traffic signals at a mixed-use urban corner. While sidewalks are present and in good condition, the environment lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and traffic calming measures to manage vehicle speeds on the one-way street.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.

hazards.name: Wide corner radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns across the pedestrian crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks and signalized traffic control within a residential row-house context. However, the wide street width and presence of parked vehicles near the crossing points may limit visibility and increase pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the image are positioned close to the crosswalk, potentially obscuring pedestrians from oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes (travel and parking) without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and signals within a mixed-use urban context. However, safety is limited by the lack of physical traffic calming measures and sightline obstructions caused by vehicles parked close to the crossing.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk on both sides of the street obstruct sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street leading up to the intersection.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Quality
hazards.description: Visible cracking and uneven surfaces in the roadway and near the crosswalk area could pose a trip hazard or affect vehicle braking.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway surface in the foreground and middle ground.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Install street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and traffic while encouraging slower vehicle speeds.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with row houses and sidewalks on both sides. A marked crosswalk is present in the foreground, but sightlines for pedestrians are partially obstructed by parked vehicles along the curb.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right curbs near the foreground crosswalk

hazards.name: Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The relatively wide, straight roadway may encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential area.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image looking down the street

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing markings to high-visibility continental style to increase driver awareness.
